name: Overload Menu
description: A huge mod menu: 270+ options. Noclip, speedhack, startpos switcher, custom icons & colours, trails, HUD, screen effects and more.

keys-title.name: Keys
keys-title.description: Every option is inside the menu itself (Tab). These are just the shortcut keys.

open-menu.name: Open the menu
open-menu.description: Opens or closes the Overload Menu anywhere in the game.

speed-up.name: Speed up
speed-up.description: Raises the speedhack speed (and turns speedhack on).

speed-down.name: Speed down
speed-down.description: Lowers the speedhack speed (and turns speedhack on).

slowmo-hold.name: Slow-mo (hold)
slowmo-hold.description: Hold in a level to play at the Slow-mo speed set in the menu.

frame-step.name: Frame stepper: step
frame-step.description: With the frame stepper on, moves the game forward one tick. Hold it to keep going.

custom-hud-text.name: Custom HUD text
custom-hud-text.description: Shown on the HUD when 'Custom text' is on (HUD tab).
